message: お汁粉縁起
Today, let's help out at Yuugiri-an.
Before dinner, the restaurant is filled with a relaxed atmosphere with few customers. Nanaka isn't here, and instead, in the seating area--

name: Shio
message: 「Now, order whatever pleases you. It is my treat.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo!　Shio-chi's tummy is all big and squishy~」

name: Shio
message: 「...What might you mean by that?」

name: Sally
message: 「It means you're big-hearted! Lolo-chi taught me that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'll have a word with Lolotte about that later.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ah, it's Prez. Hiya!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, Sir Synn. What a coincidence. Come, come, please take a seat beside us.」

name: Synn
message: 「No thanks, I came to wash dishes. I'm not a customer.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you guys having an early dinner, Shio-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay. In the middle of this month, our shrine is holding a modest ritual.」

name: Shio
message: 「For that occasion, I have come to borrow copper soup bowls from the proprietor in order to treat our parishioners to a humble meal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then why the hell are you opening the menu?」

name: Sally
message: 「Shio-chi and I came to eat snacks♪」

name: Shio
message: 「I-Indeed. Is that not what one calls proper courtesy?」

name: Shio
message: 「Moreover, Lady Sally worked diligently to clean the shrine grounds. I must reward her!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, that's so like you, Shio-chan.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm... hmm?　Everything looks so yummy♪　What should I order?」

name: Shio
message: 「Whether it be kake soba or mori soba, do not hold back.」

name: Sally
message: 「I decided, kyuru~n\s07　One Supreme Oshiruko!」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Supreme, you say?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, a flat-chested brat like her is obviously gonna pick that if there's sweets on the menu.」

name: Shio
message: 「H-How much does it cost...」
Cold sweat beads on Shio-chan's forehead.
In addition to sweet red beans and mochi, Yuugiri-an's Premium Oshiruko is packed with luxury ingredients completely foreign to my everyday diet, like candied chestnut paste and tapioca.
Naturally, it costs more than an entire year's worth of my living expenses.

name: Shio
message: 「One, two, saury's tail, gorilla's son, leafy greens...」
Under the table, Shio-chan opens a cute embroidered clasp purse and counts the cash she has on hand.

name: Shio
message: 「Ahem... Are you aware, Lady Sally? Oshiruko is actually a terribly bitter medicine, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, you're...」

name: Shio
message: 「Shhhhhhh!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ehhh, really?」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-Yes... Legend has it that in ancient times, when pestilence ran rampant in Ryuusei Town, people gathered at Asukai Shrine to pray for recovery and ate oshiruko served in copper bowls.」

name: Shio
message: 「Copper... that is to say, the color red, possesses the power to ward off pestilence--and mononoke...」

name: Shio
message: 「Therefore, if Lady Sally, being a mononoke yourself, were to eat Premium Oshiruko, something dreadful would befall you!!」

name: Shio
message: 「H-However... if it is Regular Oshiruko, it is not entirely impossible to manage...」

name: Shio
message: 「Furthermore, Regular Oshiruko is not medicine, but a sweet treat...」
I see, that whole lecture was just to lead up to this conclusion

name: Paqy
message: 「Wait a sec, what does the color of the bowl have to do with what's inside?」

name: Shio
message: 「If you point that out, it ruins the whole point.」

name: Sally
message: 「Shio-chi, I get it now. I've decided on my order.」

name: Sally
message: 「Two Regular Oshirukos!」
